description: Read the live skill and intent inventory a hub runtime exposes. Requires the hubs:inspect scope. The API answers HTTP 409 when the hub has no connected client that can report inventory — for a group-level view that returns an empty list instead of failing, use thalovant_list_runtime_group_inventory.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

name: thalovant_get_hub_runtime_capabilities
title: Get Hub Runtime Capabilities
